audit.whatIsWrong: Vel'Koz wins levels 1-5 and first item on range/poke, Zilean flips at two-plus items via Chronoshift and the double-bomb stun. Matches the packet chart.
audit.why: A single Time Bomb has an arm delay you can step out of; the double-bomb stun only exists once he ranks W enough to have both cooldowns up.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named an ability 'Tectonic Disruption' (Malphite's ult) and had no digit.
audit.why: Zilean's real numbers: Chronoshift (R) 120/90/60s, Time Bomb (Q) 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Rewind (W) 14/12/10/8/6s (reduces his other cooldowns).
audit.corrected: Chronoshift (R) is 120/90/60s — force the kill early or swap target when it glows. Time Bomb (Q) is 10-8s, but two bombs together stun, so respect the second cast. Rewind (W) drops his other cooldowns as he ranks it, up to 6s at max.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Time Bomb (Q) has an arm delay before detonating, and Chronoshift revives whoever it's cast on — both matchup-specific facts the bleed text never states.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> stepping out of the Q arm delay; dontsFull[2].d -> baiting Chronoshift before committing R.
